newsitem.title: UK: Stakis to buy Lonrho hotels - paper.
newsitem.headline: Stakis to buy Lonrho hotels - paper.

text.p: Hotels and leisure group Stakis Plc is poised to pay 350 million stg to conglomerate Lonrho Plc for its five Metropole hotels, the Independent newspaper reported in its Friday edition.
The paper said Stakis could announce the deal next week when it is sheduled to issue a trading update to investors.

The Independent predicted that Stakis would have to set a one-for-two rights issue to raise the bulk of the cash needed for the purchase. Lonrho had planned to float the Metropole hotels together with another chain, Princess, as one company but the flotation was suspended when possible buyers emerged.
